title: sync script: unchecked git add -- $touched_others at :168 lands merge commit without session's companion fixes
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 1.1/3.1 (converged). llm_semantic_merge(): 'git add -- $touched_others' (sync-beads-workers.sh:168) has no rc check and set -e is suppressed (function called in && context at :286). If the add fails (pathspec mismatch, file deleted between the :162 snapshot and the add), the function returns 0 and the caller commits the merge WITHOUT the session's compile/test companion fixes. Fix: 'git add -- $touched_others || return 1'.
